proposals.evidence: DEDR839 gives Malayalam eluvu/eluṅku, Kannada elu/eluvu/elugu/emike/emake and Toda eḷf bone. Selected survey yeḷuvā/eḷuku/yelɨyɨ/yemke/yāmukɨ/yellu and Toda eṛḷf are comparative variants preserving source initial glides, vowels and lateral notation; the śelugū form is excluded pending an explanation of its initial consonant. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3213 gives Tamil/Malayalam tiṅkaḷ, Kannada tiṅgaḷ, Kota tigḷ, Toda tïgïḷ moon and Kodagu tiŋga month. These survey tiṅga/tiṅkiya/tiṅguva/tigɨḷ-type moon responses preserve the same southern family with source lateral weakening, vowel and cluster notation. White-moon compounds are treated separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
